scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with exact-rational finite diagnostics; numerical tests are not substitutes for the theorem.
scientific_limitations: All-dimensional assertion requires m >= 3, a common positive Clayton parameter, and strictly positive orientation weights.
The theorem concerns population conditional corner-tail limits, not finite-sample estimators, independent validation, or a heterogeneous-parameter mixture.
Historical priority is provisional and depends on the checked literature.

The originating 2024 version treats the bivariate case; the multivariate model appears in a February 2025 revision of the same arXiv record. The date field is the initial posting date, not a false multivariate posting date.
title: Exact corner-tail compatibility and parameter recovery for rotated Clayton mixtures
